name: thewindpower-turbines
title: Wind turbine model table (thewindpower.net, licensed)
description: The Wind Power's turbine-model table from the subscription wind-energy database, release 2025-07-08: one row per commercial turbine model with manufacturer, rated capacity, rotor diameter, available hub heights and the identifiers that join it to the power-curve and wind-farm tables. The join key behind reskit-turbine-library.

ethos:upstream.note: thewindpower.net is live and still sells this data (checked 2026-09-07), so it is obtainable -- by buying a subscription, which is per-location and is why this dataset is restricted and never mirrored. "on-request" here means commercially, not by asking a helpdesk.

ethos:restriction: Licensed from The Wind Power (thewindpower.net) under an ICE-2 database subscription. Redistribution is prohibited: the products must not be communicated outside the licensed location, though studies based on them may be published as long as they contain no raw data from the products. ICE-2 members on the institute HPC only; contact the RESKit maintainers for access.
